title: Pig holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 35 Q58 48 55 55' stroke='#ffd6e0' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='24' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#ff4466'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='24' rx='13' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ff6688' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='19' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8899' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='62,39 68,39 65,43' fill='#ff4466'/>
  
  <!-- Pig body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffcce0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Pig legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='78' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ff99b3'/>
  <rect x='47' y='78' width='7' height='10' rx='3' fill='#ff99b3'/>
  
  <!-- Pig arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M55 62 Q60 58 58 52' stroke='#ffb3c6' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='3' fill='#ff99b3'/>
  
  <!-- Pig head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='16' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='48' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffcce0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Pig ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#ff99b3' transform='rotate(-20 30 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='36' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#ff99b3' transform='rotate(20 54 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffccdd' transform='rotate(-20 30 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='36' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffccdd' transform='rotate(20 54 36)'/>
  
  <!-- Pig eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='46' r='2' fill='#5a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='46' r='2' fill='#5a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='37.8' cy='45.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49.8' cy='45.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- Pig snout -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='53' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#ff99b3'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='53' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#ffccdd' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='53' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e07090'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='53' rx='1.5' ry='2' fill='#e07090'/>
  
  <!-- Pig mouth -->
  <path d='M39 57 Q42 59 45 57' stroke='#e07090' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff7799' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff7799' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Pig tail -->
  <path d='M22 64 Q16 60 18 55 Q20 50 25 53' stroke='#ff99b3' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
